snippet.title: Paleo Dive: Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Dive into the official gameplay reveal for Paleo Dive.

Paleo Dive is a prehistoric underwater VR adventure in which you explore ancient oceans across different geological periods, discover fossils, complete research objectives and encounter extinct marine creatures face-to-face — from early sea life to Mosasaurs and Megalodon.

Return to your research base between dives to purchase equipment, unlock upgrades and prepare for deeper and more dangerous expeditions.

This trailer shows actual gameplay from the current PCVR development build. The game is still in development, so some visuals, animations and gameplay systems will change before release.

Wishlist Paleo Dive on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4818760/Paleo_Dive/?l=german
